item.title: Redstone Add-On 4.0
item.creator: Pixelbiester
item.description:
Enhance the power of Redstone and unlock new ways to build, plan and run your coolest machines. These more than 20 new devices can break blocks, farm mobs, sort items, teleport anything, and much, much more!

+ 44 new Redstone powered blocks
+ Connecting conveyor belt system
+ 6 Redstone mining machines
+ Capable of fully automated mob farms

WATCH THE TRAILER!
item.changelog: Update 4.0: Sensor Update - 11 new Redstone devices - added new sensor blocks to detect light, speed, blocks and eye contact - compact arithmetic gates for calculations - new redstone pulser and pulse trigger - improvements & bug fixes
item.howToTitle: Getting Started with Redstone + Block and Functions

howToEntries.heading: Redstone Station
howToEntries.content: Your first objective is to build a Redstone Station. To unlock the recipe, just collect one Redstone Dust and craft it at a normal crafting table. The Redstone Station is a special crafting station where all new Redstone Add-On blocks, machinery, and devices are crafted. Apart from certain recipes, it works like a regular crafting table.

howToEntries.heading: Redstone Wrench
howToEntries.content: The Redstone Wrench is a handy tool to have around at all times. Use it to read out signal strength, rotate and configure machinery blocks and devices, display Drill upgrade levels, and remove Elevator Platforms. Craft it at the Redstone Station.

howToEntries.heading: Blocks & Functions
howToEntries.content:
Conveyor: Moves items and entities.

Item Teleporter: Teleports items between linked blocks.

Item Filter: Sorts items between outputs.

Custom Repeater: Sets custom signal delays.

Redstone Counter: Counts input signals before outputting.

Redstone Randomizer: Randomly redirects signals.

Wireless Redstone: Transmits signals wirelessly.

Redstone Display: Displays signal strength.

Redstone Looper: Repeats signals at set intervals.

Entity Sensor: Detects selected entities.

Rain Sensor: Outputs a signal during rain.

Spike: Damages mobs and generates XP.

Lava Spike: Damages mobs and cooks meat.

XP Tank: Stores up to 10,000 XP.

Entity Teleporter: Teleports entities between linked blocks.

Breeder: Automatically breeds mobs.

Bucket Refiller: Automatically fills containers.

Block Dispenser: Places blocks when powered.

Redstone Saw: Automatically cuts trees.

Redstone Drill: Automatically breaks blocks and ores.

Remote Redstone: Controls Redstone remotely.

Elevator: Moves platforms vertically.

Hopper Dropper: Moves item stacks between containers.

Fan: Pushes or pulls entities.

Item Magnet: Pulls nearby items.

Transplanter: Automatically plants seeds.

Super Smelter: Automatically smelts items.

Ore Refiner: Converts ores into materials.

Ore Detector: Detects nearby ores.

Grinder: Grinds materials into resources.

Fertilizer: Automatically fertilizes plants.

Auto Composter: Makes bone meal from organic items.

Harvester: Automatically harvests crops.

Portable Drill: Mines blocks from a minecart.

Portable Dropper: Drops items from a minecart.

Portable Block Dispenser: Places blocks from a minecart.

Portable Magnet: Attracts items from a minecart.

Rail Placer: Automatically places rails.

Quarry Machine: Automatically mines and builds tracks.

Redstone Alarm: Alerts the owner when powered.

Wire Gutter: Transfers Redstone signals.

Wire Elevator: Transfers signals in all directions.

Logic Gate: Processes Redstone inputs.

Redstone Latch: Toggles its output state.

Flying Machine: Moves blocks and itself.

Super Piston: Pushes up to 50 blocks.

Jump Pad: Launches entities into the air.

Mob Generator: Spawns mobs using coal.

Block Rotator: Rotates blocks.

Colored Redstone Lamps & Copper Bulbs: Adds 16 colored Redstone Lamps and colored Copper Bulbs.
